name: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken Thighs
instructions:
1. Heat oven to 425°F.
2. Toss potatoes with half the oil, salt and pepper; roast 10 minutes.
3. Rub chicken with garlic, lemon zest, oregano and the rest of the oil; add to the pan with the broccoli.
4. Roast 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F. Squeeze lemon over everything.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions:
1. Start the rice.
2. Toss beef with cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
3. Sear beef in a hot oiled pan in batches; set aside.
4. Stir-fry broccoli with garlic and ginger 3 minutes, add a splash of water to steam.
5. Return beef with the remaining soy, oyster sauce and sugar; toss until glossy. Serve over rice.

name: Weeknight Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions:
1. Brown beef with onion and carrot.
2. Add garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute, then tomatoes and oregano; simmer 20 minutes.
3. Cook spaghetti; toss with sauce and top with parmesan.

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions:
1. Toss chicken with seasoning.
2. Sear chicken in a hot pan until cooked; set aside.
3. Cook peppers and onions until charred at the edges.
4. Return chicken, squeeze lime over, and serve in warm tortillas with toppings.

name: Honey Garlic Salmon with Rice
instructions:
1. Start the rice.
2. Whisk honey, soy, garlic and lemon juice.
3. Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip, pour the sauce in and simmer 3–4 minutes, spooning it over.
4. Steam or sauté the green beans and serve.

name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
instructions:
1. In the morning: rub pork with sugar and paprika, put on the onion in the slow cooker with the broth.
2. Cook on low 8 hours.
3. Shred, stir in barbecue sauce.
4. Toss coleslaw mix with mayo and serve on buns.

name: Black Bean Quesadillas
instructions:
1. Mash half the beans with cumin; stir in the rest and the corn.
2. Fill tortillas with beans and cheese and fold.
3. Cook in a dry pan 2–3 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with salsa and sliced avocado.

name: Chicken Caesar Wraps
instructions:
1. Shred the chicken.
2. Chop the romaine and toss with dressing, parmesan and crushed croutons.
3. Fill tortillas with chicken and salad and roll up.

name: Thai Red Curry with Chicken
instructions:
1. Start the rice.
2. Fry curry paste in a little oil 1 minute, add chicken and brown.
3. Add coconut milk, pepper, fish sauce and sugar; simmer 12 minutes.
4. Stir in spinach and lime juice.

name: Turkey Taco Bowls
instructions:
1. Start the rice.
2. Brown turkey, add seasoning and 1/3 cup water; simmer 5 minutes.
3. Warm the beans.
4. Build bowls with rice, turkey, beans, lettuce, cheese, salsa and avocado.

name: Baked Cod with Roasted Vegetables
instructions:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Roast vegetables with oil 10 minutes.
2. Nestle cod among the vegetables, top with butter, garlic and lemon slices.
3. Roast 10–12 minutes until the fish flakes.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
instructions:
1. Cook penne.
2. Season and sear chicken until cooked; slice.
3. In the same pan cook garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, add cream and parmesan, then spinach until wilted.
4. Toss with pasta and chicken.

name: Pork Chops with Apples and Sweet Potatoes
instructions:
1. Roast sweet potatoes at 425°F for 25 minutes.
2. Sear chops 4 minutes a side; rest.
3. In the pan cook onion and apples in butter with thyme; add cider and reduce.
4. Serve chops with apples and sweet potatoes.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice with Egg
instructions:
1. Scramble eggs in a hot oiled pan; set aside.
2. Stir-fry garlic and vegetables 3 minutes.
3. Add rice and fry until hot and a little crisp.
4. Add soy, sesame oil, eggs and green onions.

name: Shrimp Tacos with Lime Slaw
instructions:
1. Toss coleslaw with sour cream, lime juice and cilantro.
2. Season shrimp with chili powder and salt; sear 2 minutes a side.
3. Warm tortillas and fill with shrimp, slaw and avocado.

name: Classic Beef Chili
instructions:
1. Brown beef with onion and pepper.
2. Add spices, tomatoes and beans; simmer 40 minutes.
3. Serve with cheese and sour cream.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Bowls
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in lemon, oregano, oil, salt 15 minutes. Start the rice.
2. Cook chicken in a hot pan or grill 8–10 minutes.
3. Chop cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
4. Serve over rice with feta, tzatziki and warm pita.

name: Homemade Margherita Pizza Night
instructions:
1. Heat oven to 500°F with a pan or stone inside.
2. Stretch dough, top with sauce and both cheeses.
3. Bake 10–12 minutes; top with basil and a drizzle of oil.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions:
1. Simmer chicken in broth with onion, carrot, celery and thyme 20 minutes.
2. Shred chicken; return to the pot.
3. Add noodles and cook 7 minutes. Finish with parsley.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowls
instructions:
1. Start the rice.
2. Sear chicken pieces until cooked, add teriyaki and simmer to glaze.
3. Steam broccoli.
4. Serve over rice with carrot, green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Lentil and Sweet Potato Curry
instructions:
1. Soften onion with curry powder.
2. Add sweet potato, lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 2 cups water; simmer 25 minutes.
3. Stir in spinach. Serve with rice and naan.

name: Smash Burgers and Oven Fries
instructions:
1. Cut potatoes into fries, toss with oil and salt, bake at 425°F for 30 minutes.
2. Roll beef into 12 balls; smash thin on a very hot pan, 2 minutes a side, cheese on top.
3. Build burgers with the toppings.

name: Sausage and Pepper Sheet Pan
instructions:
1. Heat oven to 425°F.
2. Toss everything with oil and seasoning on a sheet pan.
3. Roast 30 minutes, turning once.

name: Breakfast for Dinner
instructions:
1. Bake bacon on a sheet at 400°F for 18 minutes.
2. Mix and cook pancakes.
3. Scramble the eggs.
4. Serve with berries and syrup.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
instructions:
1. Cook linguine; save 1 cup pasta water.
2. Cook shrimp in butter with garlic 2 minutes a side.
3. Add spinach, lemon and pasta, loosen with pasta water, finish with parmesan and parsley.

name: Korean Ground Beef Bowls
instructions:
1. Start the rice.
2. Brown beef with garlic and ginger.
3. Add soy, sugar and sesame oil; simmer 2 minutes.
4. Serve over rice with sliced cucumber and green onion.

name: Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables
instructions:
1. Heat oven to 425°F.
2. Cut vegetables into chunks and spread in a roasting pan.
3. Rub chicken with butter, salt and pepper; stuff with lemon and rosemary; set on the vegetables.
4. Roast about 80 minutes until 165°F in the thigh; rest 10 minutes.

name: Baked Chicken Parmesan
instructions:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Halve breasts into thin cutlets.
2. Dip in egg, then panko mixed with parmesan; bake 15 minutes.
3. Top with marinara and mozzarella; bake 10 more. Cook spaghetti and serve with the salad.

name: Minestrone Soup with Crusty Bread
instructions:
1. Soften onion, carrot and celery.
2. Add zucchini, tomatoes, broth and beans; simmer 15 minutes.
3. Add pasta for 8 minutes, then spinach. Serve with bread.

name: Steak Night with Baked Potatoes
instructions:
1. Bake potatoes at 425°F for 50 minutes.
2. Bring steaks to room temperature, season well.
3. Sear 3–4 minutes a side for medium-rare; rest with butter on top.
4. Roast asparagus for the last 10 minutes.

name: Leftover Remix Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Scramble eggs and set aside.
2. Fry rice with leftovers and peas until hot.
3. Add soy and eggs.
